title: Player
description: A player participating in a room.

id.description: Stable player identifier, such as a UUID.

name.description: The display name selected by the player.

role.description: The assigned role. SECRET: never included in public room broadcasts; only sent privately to the owning player (and revealed in game:over).

isAlive.description: Whether the player is active in the current game.

isHost.description: Whether the player created and administers the room.

joinedAt.description: Timestamp at which the player joined the room.
